what: Over the panels (video window · large photo link), a translucent white circle 67px in diameter containing VIEW follows in place of the system cursor (difference blending, so the video colors look inverted) — the mouse position is picked up after a 50ms pause (every 100ms while moving) and moved over with .3s ease-out, so it arrives late in a choppy way. The circle is fixed to the screen and clipped by the panel’s clip-path, so it is visible only inside the panel.

options.text: Text inside the circle, default VIEW — [data-fx-part=If you put a child directly in disc], it is used
options.wait: Delay (ms) before the mouse settles into place after resting, default 50
options.most: Longest interval (ms) for taking a position while moving, default 100
options.follow: Duration of moving to the new position (s), default .3
options.x·y: Starting position (px, relative to screen), default 0·0 — in the original the cursor sits at the screen’s top left before the mouse enters
options.--fx-disc: (css) circle background, default --kf-bg 80% — blends via difference

note: The panel gets clip-path: inset(0) (same as the original) — any child sticking out of the panel is clipped with it. Not applied on touch devices (the original also removes #pointer)

from.where: index.html .sk-stage (original #main .sec03 #pointer.hover — lodash debounce 50ms·maxWait 100, moved with matrix on every rAF and transition transform ease-out .3s, 6.7rem white 80% circle with mix-blend-mode difference)
